expires_today.title: Eat Your Protein! A Keto Cookbook Bundle for Carnivores by Page Street Publishing
expires_today.long_description: Learn how to cook healthy, nutritious, and delicious meals that cater to a variety of dietary restrictions with the Eat Your Protein: A Keto Cookbook Bundle for Carnivores by Page Street Publishing! This 25‑book collection is stacked with mouth‑watering recipes from critically acclaimed chefs and authors like Vivica Menegaz and Danielle Lima! Delete boring weeknight meals with recipes from hot titles like The Essential Carnivore Diet Cookbook and High‑Protein Macros Made Easy all for a price you choose. Add new flavors to your repertoire, and help support World Central Kitchen with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Crawling Through the Dungeons
expires_today.description: The depths are calling your name!

Experience certified classics for the first time with the legacy titles or dive into the latest iterations like Mega Man X Dive OFFLINE all for a price you choose. expires_today.title: CRPG Pack: Isometric Immersion
expires_today.long_description:
Isometric games—that is, games that use a little projection trick to make the map look 3-D—give players a whole new way to move their characters around a world. More fantastic adventures and unforgettable stories await you in this bundle of isometric classics, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Little Free Library with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 23rd, 2027

expires_today.title: The Greg Bear Birthday Bundle by Open Road Media
expires_today.description: Celebrate the birthday of one of sci-fi’s masters
expires_today.long_description: The world of science fiction lost a titan when novelist Greg Bear passed away in 2022, but his books remain a perfect example of exactly what sci-fi was always meant to be. Author of over 50 books and co-founder of San Diego Comic Con, Bear made loving sci-fi into a career that spanned five decades. His work, which tested the limits of human (and non-human) consciousness and looked toward the far future and beyond, inspires and excites readers to this day. To celebrate what would have been Greg Bear’s 75th Birthday, in partnership with Open Road Media, we’ve collected a bundle of his best novels including award-winning classics like first contact thriller Eon, alien invasion drama The Forge of God, and post-apocalyptic space odyssey Anvil of Stars! Get a motherlode of some of the best sci-fi ever written for the price of your choosing, and support the Science Fiction & Fantasy Writers Association with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Make & Play Games in Godot
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Become a game dev mastermind when you harness the power of Godot! Learn how to create your own action RPG from the ground up with compelling combat mechanics, develop your own gravity-defying 3D platformer, build a 2D action-adventure game, and so much more with this curated bundle of approachable learning courses. Harness the power of Godot to bring your dream game to life, all for a price you choose. Plus pick up three games created with Godot: Buckshot Roulette, Windowkill, and The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition! Unlock the very best from GameDev.TV and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase.

expires_within_72h.title: Dungeon Master's Guild Top Content from the D&D Community
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Eager to kick off your next tabletop campaign but not sure where to start? How about a library of fan-favorite Dungeon Master’s Guild manuals, guides, adventures, and more, chosen by the community? Take on the elder gods of the astral plane in Forgotten Realms’ Call from the Deep! Rewrite classic myths and monster lore with the first volume of Uncaged! Populate your land with beasts and bosses with the Monster Manual Expanded for 5E, and Villains and Lairs! There’s plenty more to explore in this bundle of valuable resources, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Extra Life charity with your purchase!

The ebooks in this bundles are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website. Keys expire on October 3, 2027. Please redeem before this date.

expires_within_72h.title: JROTools Pro Photobash Reference Megapack
expires_within_72h.long_description:
JROTools reference packs provide royalty‑free, high‑resolution image libraries created for 3D artists, concept artists, and texture artists in a variety of styles. Unlock packs like Japan Traditional Vol. 1‑4 and Weapons & Military Vol. 5‑9—perfect for visual reference, photo‑bashing, texturing, and matte painting, these packs provide the royalty‑free assets you need to add professional‑quality polish to your projects. Pay what you want for elite protobash packs, and help support Save The Children with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 3, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Run It Back - Roguelikes Bundle
expires_within_72h.description: Don’t be afraid to start over
expires_within_72h.long_description:
There are few things as high-octane as playing a fantastic roguelike game with real consequences, and to celebrate a few of our favorites we’ve collected them all in this convenient roguelike games bundle! Mine for resources to build your home and fight monsters on an alien planet in Dome Keeper! Battle your way to the top in the adorably rabbit-themed co-op game Rabbit and Steel! Save the Twisted World from falling into chaos in the single-player deckbuilder Chrono Ark! And if you die, just start all over again! There’s even more fun to be had in this bundle of roguelikes, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Team Rubicon with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 2nd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Decked Out Deckbuilders
expires_within_72h.long_description:
When the decks are stacked against you, there’s only one thing left to do—gather all the cards you can to build a bigger, better deck, and win! These deckbuilder games give players an opportunity to do just that, in a variety of different genres and exciting stories. The Roaring Twenties never looked as terrifying as they do in Cultist Simulator: Anthology Edition, where players summon otherworldly gods and steal hidden treasures. Lovecraftian occult reigns supreme in Menace from the Deep, where a secret society seeks the mythos of ancient monsters. Habitat preservation is the name of the game in Wingspan, where attracting as many birds to your deck as possible is your goal. There’s so much more to explore in this bundle of deckbuilders, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Worldreader with your purchase!!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 2nd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.long_description: Some of the greatest writers and artists in comics have left their mark on the Valiant Universe. Now, their extraordinary work comes together in one massive Humble Bundle. From X-O Manowar and Bloodshot to Harbinger, Eternal Warrior, Shadowman and beyond, this isn't simply a collection of great Valiant stories. It's a showcase of the creators who made Valiant legendary. Explore an incredible collection of Valiant comics, choose your price, and support BINC with your purchase. The heroes are iconic. The creators are legendary. The Valiant Universe is yours.
